feeds.title: Mustang Specs
feeds.description: The Richest Source of Ford Mustang Data, Specs, & Model History Online. Up to date news, rumors, updates, spy shots, & more. Stay up to date with the latest news about America's favorite sports car, the Ford Mustang! From Mustang news to the latest developments at Ford HQ, upcoming model spy shots to Ford racing achievements, you'll find our editors talking about everything Ford Mustang related right here.

feeds.title: FordMuscle
feeds.description: Ford Muscle Magazine is dedicated to covering Ford performance from classic Mustangs to the latest S550 and beyond. From the latest news on new models, the hottest car features, DIY tech on modernizing pushrod engines, and squeezing more power out of the Coyote, Ford Muscle delivers all the blue oval content you can handle. Ford Muscle combines timeless content in the world of blue oval pushrods and early mod motors with fast, hard-hitting content on next-generation Ford performance.

feeds.title: The Mustang Source
feeds.description: Your Source for Ford Mustang News, Rumors, and Owner Information. TheMustangSource.com, built by enthusiasts, run by enthusiasts, all for enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Mustang Maniac
feeds.description: Mustang Maniac is the place for all your Mustang needs, Restoration, Parts, Service or complete custom builds to your specifications. Mustang Maniac was founded Adam Longmore, it started as his hobby and has now become his business. For over 30 years Adam has been an enthusiastic collector of classic Mustangs. Favoring 64-66 cars he has amassed quite the collection over the years.

feeds.title: Virginia Classic Mustang Blog
feeds.description: We have been serving Mustang Hobby for over 40 years by providing quality parts with great service and reasonable prices. Check out our web site. We started this Blog to share pictures, show new parts, and just talk about 64 1/2-73 Mustangs. We love to feature Customer Cars also. We take pride in offering excellent service, quality parts, a huge inventory and reasonable prices. We are Mustang enthusiasts just like you! We 'grew up' with the Mustang Hobby and started selling parts for 1964 ½-73 model Mustangs over 35 years ago.

feeds.title: Mustang Fan Club
feeds.description: Find the latest Mustang news including product releases, current events and happening, new body styles, product reviews, installations, and much more. Mustang Fan Club was created on September 12th, 2012. We at Mustang Fan Club would like to make the Mustang community a tight-knit family of owners and enthusiasts. Also, we would like to help companies within the industry reach out to potential clients and get to know their customers on a more personal level.

feeds.title: One Man And His Mustang
feeds.description: This is A Classic 1966 Ford Mustang v8 Coupe Restoration Guide. I'm just a man with a Classic 1966 Ford Mustang Coupe and a collection of tools that just got bigger in order that I could do the job right. When I first started this blog it was only intended to be a personal build diary for me. I started to get a few questions and the whole thing just evolved into something much bigger, the site as it is now.

feeds.title: Mustang Restoration Blog
feeds.description: This is a site dedicated to the restoration of a 1965 Mustang Fastback that I bought in November of 2005. The restoration has been delayed by my free time (or lack of) and the advanced state of decay the car was in - which I wish I had realized before I bought it.

feeds.title: Northern Utah Mustang Owners Association Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for reviews, restoration news, show events scheduled and more! Northern Utah Mustang Owners Association began in 1996. Butterfield Ford which used to be located in Sandy, UT became a car show sponsor in 2001. After Butterfield became Champion Ford, part of the Larry Miller group, the sponsorship grew. We are now sponsored by the Larry H.

feeds.title: duPont REGISTRY News » Ford Mustang
feeds.description: See the latest Mustang news, photos, videos and reviews from around the world. For over the past three decades, duPont REGISTRY has been the world's premiere exotic car marketplace. With so much knowledge around supercars and luxury cars, we've shared our expertise with everyone. From exotic car reviews to automotive events and even road trips, you'll find the best of the best here.

feeds.title: Mustang Car Club of New England Blog
feeds.description: Explore more information on Mustang, car models, shows and more. In 1978, the Mustang Car Club of New England (MCCNE) was formed. The mission of the club is to preserve and maintain a living history of the legendary Ford Mustang. The club's motto is 'Preservation of the Breed'.
